notes.title: Warstride Challenges leaves Early Access September 7!
notes.content:
After more than a year in Early Access, [i][b]Warstride Challenges[/b][/i] is finally ready to launch its 1.0 version September 7! Eliminate all the demons in your path at lightning speed and get ready for all the challenges ahead with our new [b]Gameplay Overview Trailer[/b]!

[previewyoutube=Z4QB-NCY7IQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Balanced for the best experience for all players[/h3]

After almost [b]one year of Early Access to listen to the community feedback, we added loads of content[/b]. More than [b]60 intense trials[/b] have been added to the game, which ranges [b]from beginners content to the Very Hard difficulty[/b] mode for the most hardcore players of our community. We also debuted [b]fresh abilities and a new weapon[/b] to offer alternative ways to play. Burst your way through demons with [b]the stomp[/b], give foes your best headshot to foes with the carabin, and fling yourself around the stages as you unlock new maneuvers with [b]the grappling hook[/b].

To increase the competition between players, [b]we added the live multiplayer mode to race against your friends[/b] and finally find out which of you is the FPS master. Since we started early access, we have dedicated a lot of time and love to our community of builders on PC in order to [b]bring them the tools they needed to create the best levels for fellow players[/b]. On top of all that, with the 1.0 we will bring you even more content with tons of unfamiliar levels, and brand new gamemode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/d29fadb4082c9086cbe99aaf9e06200a83053cdb.gif[/img]

[b]Easy to learn but hard to master[/b], Warstride Challenges is made for anyone who wants to race and shoot demons at lightning speed whether they have never touched a computer or are seasoned tactical shooting veterans. [b]With an average of 92% of positive reviews[/b] from our players on Steam, we believe that speedrunners and shooter fans can find the challenging die & retry loop they deserve. [b]Compete with your friends and the community to get the highest score and race the ghosts of anyone online – even your favorite streamers![/b]

[b][i]Warstride Challenges[/i] 1.0 officially launches on September 7 with boat loads of new content on Steam. Experience high-speed shooting right [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/?l=french]now with Early Access[/url]. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/

Burst your way through demons with the stomp, give foes your best headshot to foes with the carabin, and fling yourself around the stages as you unlock new maneuvers with the grappling hook.
To increase the competition between players, we added the live multiplayer mode to race against your friends and finally find out which of you is the FPS master.
Since we started early access, we have dedicated a lot of time and love to our community of builders on PC in order to bring them the tools they needed to create the best levels for fellow players.
On top of all that, with the 1.0 we will bring you even more content with tons of unfamiliar levels, and brand new gamemode.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

Warstride Challenges just released a new major update full of content, adding the[b] Live Multiplayer mode[/b] and additional options and [b]content to the Level Editor.[/b] Time to challenge your friends in epic real-time races!
Discover it all in the new trailer now!

[previewyoutube=U4XA_dhCx_M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A new multiplayer mode, and more![/h2]

This new update brings the[b] new Live Multiplayer mode[/b] for real-time speedruns, giving the Warstride community yet another opportunity to challenge each other as players[b] compete simultaneously through cups, a playlist of levels.[/b] New perspectives for a custom Warstride experience don’t stop here, and players can now access the [b]exciting new array of options brought to the Level Editor.[/b] An ever-improving feature of the game thanks to the community’s active feedback and sharings, the Level Editor keeps extending its functionalities, with a map curation and decorative objects. 

[h2]An Early Access full of content [/h2]

[b]The previous updates already brought 60 levels, 6 bonus levels, 10 Big Fun Levels including new powers such as the Stomp and the Grappling Hook[/b] to kill your enemies with style. With all the improvements added to the [b]Level Editor[/b], players can also enjoy [b]new levels and share their creations[/b] with the community. The devs are always [b]working to continuously improve the game[/b] experience and integrate community feedback [b]before the 1.0 release. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/9ff41e66d8253ca83a06987e85d3f7cd08d7924e.gif[/img]

[b]Warstride Challenges is available in Early Access on Steam, join in today to enjoy the newest update, and blast hordes of demons frenetically. To celebrate the release of the new update, enjoy a 25% time limited discount on Steam![/b]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[b]Here’s a recap of the Update 7 content:[/b]

[b]Multiplayer mode[/b]: New mode that allows you to play in 8 players lobbys, in a Time Attack game mode
[b]New Tutorial[/b]: A  long tutorial that looks like a BFL instead of the previous fractioned tutos
[b]Level Editor[/b]:  
[list]
[*] Crypt solo elements
[*] All weapons pick up
[*] Power up pick up
[*] New enemies : Bull plasma, Explo Recon, Dual Recon. Every enemies are now available in the Editor
[*] Lava and Poison blocks
[*] Spike traps
[/list]
[b][h3]Known Issues[/h3][/b]
[b]Core game[/b]
[list]
[*] "Ready" button stay ready even if we unready in Multiplayer Lobby, if a player was ready when the Host made change in the Lobby settings.
[*] Gamepad key binds from Controls Settings are not translated
[*] The grapple rope stay attached to the player arm when hiding the hUD after using the grappling hook
[/list]
[b]Level Editor[/b]
[list]
[*] The dual Recon use jetpack event if the setting is not enabled 
[*] Spike Trap : "In to Out Wait" appears twice instead of "In to Out Time" in the object settings
[*] The big gun is not relaoded when collecting a pickup big gun if we launch the level with no weapons
[*] Most static mesh cause selection bug
[*] Levels using title and description with special characters are empty and can't stay downloaded in the Play tab of the community levels
[*] The placeable elements in the level editor are not translated
[/list]
[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
[b]Block/ Major fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now grab urns and barrels if you map another action on the same button
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies stopped moving and only made small steps toward the player in Bonus 6 level
[*] Additional slow motion in levels without base slow motion will now be given to players who activated the assistance "More Slow-motion".
[*] Fixed a bug where all campaign levels were displayed as new after launching a community level
[*] Localization have been added in Level Editor, all following languages are now available : EN - FR - DE - ES - RU - Simp.Chinese
[*] When trying to load a level in Level Editor, the Save pop-up is no longer displayed
[*] Multiple UI issues in Level Editor have been fixed : Logic system, Weapons displayed, World Settings.
[/list]
[b]Additionnal Minor bug fixes[/b]

notes.title: New levels and new gears in Update 4, now available! + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We’re adding plenty of new content with today’s update, bringing a new chapter with its batch of original levels and two new gears: the Grappling Hook and the Rocket Launcher! Check out the fresh new content from this update in the trailer!

[previewyoutube=eytw-s12n9s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New challenges await you[/h2]

This new update starts unveiling Chapter 3, which the community has been awaiting, bringing 24 new and more open levels, as well as new bonus levels. You’ll find several challenges in two different difficulty modes—normal and hard—and bonus levels to unlock thanks to feats and discoveries.

Fire your weapon through The Forge, a hellish new environment. Spill demon blood all over its wide rooms, and face ever more ferocious enemies, ever difficult goals! Be even faster than before, choose the right weapons and reach the finish line within the time limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/0cb838ed26e7c9f4c1ac56a9075d0af3e3e92144.gif[/img]

[h2]New weapons and new explosive ability[/h2]

On top of other recent updates, which already introduced new challenges, a new ability, new content for the Level Editor and various improvements, this update brings the Grappling Hook and the Rocket Launcher! Use your hook on platforms to increase your speed and taste the power of an all-new weapon to blast all enemies standing on your way. Finally, thanks to the implementation of an aim-assist, you may now kill your opponents in style using an impressive 360 noscope of the highest standard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/0ff47468cba43df4e94dfa2429cf808733abb1b3.gif[/img]

[b]Warstride Challenges is available in Early Access on Steam, join in today to enjoy the newest update, and blast hordes of demons frenetically. To celebrate the release of the new update, enjoy a 50% time limited discount on Steam![/b]

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[b]GAME[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] 24 New Levels, introducing the Forge
[*] 6 New Bonus Levels
[*] New Weapon: Rocket Launcher
[*] New Movement : Rocket Jump
[*] New Power: Grappling Hook
[*] New Enemies:
[list]
[*] Explosive Recon
[*] Crazy Recon
[*] Hyperion Heavy Buster
[/list]
[/list][b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Gamepad option added to Calibration.
[*] Additional controller support.
[*] ‘Disable Weapons Muzzle’ added to Video options.
[*] Removed the man.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Better behavior when creating a profile offline.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor could disappear on the Calibration screen.
[*] Fixed some collision issues in BFL-2 Very Hard.
[*] Fixed some collision issues in Ruins-16 Very Hard.
[*] Fixed incorrect flow when exiting to menu after playing a community level.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Stomp power did not appear in a level’s loadout.
[*] Jucati Scrick will always remain in turret mode in game even if we disable the setting
[/list]
[b]Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Gameplay Assists
[list]
[*] Aim Assist
[*] Increased Bronze Time
[*] More Slow Motion
[*] Automatic 360
[*] No Reload
[/list]
[*] Level times achieved with assists enabled are tracked on a separate leaderboard.
[/list]

[b]LEVEL EDITOR[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Railgun to the Weapon Options
[*] Added the Rocket Launcher to the Weapon Options.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Turret mode is no longer enabled by default for the Scrik’o’ra.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the ammunition settings for the Carabine.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Carabine appeared in already published levels.
[*] Fixed various focus issues when changing menus.
[*] 10 Carbine bullets are added in all the community levels created on a previous version
[*] The magazins and bullets values for the Carbine always come back to 2

notes.title: Update 3 and Reaction Trailer!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Striders![/h2]

We’re delighted to see everyone’s reaction to Warstride Challenges! We made a little compilation of your best moments, we hope you’ll like it! Discover joy, excitement and maybe a bit of rage from our players in today’s Reaction Trailer, as well as the warm reception from press! 

[previewyoutube=FFFUAB-hEn0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Warstride journey continues[/h2]

Following its recent Early Access launch on Steam, Warstride has already dropped a series of updates, introducing 24 new challenges by adding the Very Hard levels to Chapters 1 and 2, a deadly new power—Stomp, a more accessible Level Editor, and improved UI and functionality with a new main menu and bug fixes.

Even more lands today with 4 new ‘Big Fun Levels’ added to Chapters 1 and 2 in Very Hard, as well as new content for the level editor such as the Carabine! The community has a lot to still look forward to in Warstride Challenges! Read down below for the complete patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/9655485316b90cd9791d4cd3b62ad5655daab418.png[/img]

[h2]Race, aim, fire![/h2]

In intense trials, blast hordes of demons at lightning speed before the timer runs out. Die and retry to get to the finish line and achieve the highest score. Since its launch in Early Access, many players and influencers have battled through the game—their reactions were priceless! 

Warstride Challenges is a community-driven game at heart where you can share your experience with others. Compete with anyone — be it friends, foes or streamers — in the Nemesis Mode, where you can race asynchronously in any challenge. The community has also already made incredible use of the game’s Level Editor, with some notorious trials already available to test your mettle.

Warstride Challenges is available on Steam in Early Access. Check out the Early Access Road Map to see all the planned upcoming content.


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]GAME[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 new BFL (Very Hard Crypt & Ruins)
[*] Ruins-16 Very Hard heavily modified (Scores and Ghosts for the level have been reset)
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved tunnel collisions in Ruins-21.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The slide animation has been fixed.
[*] We can't create a profile after sending a name request offline
[*] Quick scrolling through the leaderboards jumbles the text
[*] Tab doesn't cycle correctly when using A & E in the level selection menu
[*] Closing the community level window after leaving a level bring back to the chapter selection menu
[*] Bunny Hop II: Main level medals are displayed on the scorescreen instead of "A,B,C" medals
[*] When players have too many weapons the 5th one will not appear in the bottom right corner
[*] Using "Return to menu" in the pause menu should bring back to the Main Menu
[/list]
[b]Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*] New button icon added for when a button is off.
[*] Button icon changes with the color when activated.
[*] The Lever Activation sound is now louder.
[/list]
[b]LEVEL EDITOR[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Carabine to Weapon Selection.
[*] Added Stomp to Power Selection.
[*] Added Logic to Trigger Boxes.
[*] Activation Delay: Delays activation of all linked elements.
[*] Reset: Removes all linked elements.
[*] Added additional Logic to enemy spawns:
[*] Activation Delay: Delays enemy spawn time in seconds.
[*] Is Optional Spawner: The enemy does not need to be killed to finish the level.
[*] Turret Mode: Enemies remain in place of their spawn.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Right-side Panel has been reworked :
[*] New UI (Not final design)
[*] Separate sections for Game Rules, Loadout, and Logic.
[*] Trigger boxes and enemies now fall under Logic in the Side Panel.
[*] Enemies linked to a trigger box are now labeled
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Load and Delete buttons disappear if the map name is too long
[*] Help panel remains when opening the settings menu
[*] Directional controls stop working after using the level editor guide link
[*] You can overwrite your previous level if you quit to main menu and restart a new map
[*] Can't go back with the cursor in the Submit level textbox
[*] Added helpers are out of step with the preview
[*] Camera and Shortcuts become locked after canceling a level submission.
[/list]

notes.title: Warstride Challenges ramps up the challenge with its first update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[b]2 weeks after its Early Access launch, Warstride Challenges releases its first update today,[/b] available for all players on [b]Steam![/b]
[b]The first of many,[/b] this update sees [b]the arrival of Very Hard mode for Chapter 1, and improvements for the Level Editor.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/b70ab66198b63c253ebfba01dae4b0f6eca9499d.png[/img]

[h2]The Warstride journey begins with the first of many updates[/h2]

This first update gives you a first taste of the [b]Very Hard difficulty level, unlocking it for Chapter 1 with 12 additional levels.[/b] Do you have what it takes to beat the clock? Furthermore, [b]many improvements and fixes[/b] have been made, with a focus on [b]making the Level Editor more accessible and precise[/b] with quality of life improvements and additional blocks. [b]More details in the patch notes below. [/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1608470]A Level Editor Guide[/url] has also been created to give you tips about map creation.[/b] Creating your own devious and sadistic trials is now easier than ever - [b]let your imagination run wild and don’t hesitate to share your creations with the community![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/c3aa7dd12494e566ee4bf83fbc2316ae79b13abb.gif[/img]

[h2]Warstride Challenges You![/h2]

The community contest is now over. Our winners will get some awesome prizes thanks to our partner Intel, but that’s not all! To reward all of our participants and amazing community, we’re offering a promo code for redemption on the Focus Store. Stay tuned for more exciting contests in the coming weeks! #WarstrideChallenges

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608470/Warstride_Challenges/

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]GAME[/h3]

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] 12 very hard level from Chapter 1: Crypt
[*] Added bindings for StatMenu, ToggleGhost,ToggleHud
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Tuto quick restart, platform are now more obvious
[*] Tuto quick restart, fixed trigger for restart tip
[*] Hole and floating stone in Crypt 3 Hard
[*] Collisions issues in Crypt 9 Side room
[*] Crypt 9 Hard is now Very Hard, and Very Hard is Hard (score have been reset)
[*] BFL Crypt 2: Hard leaderboard reset due to change of Crypt 9
[*] Button inside walls in low settings in Ruins 15
[*] Reload tips won’t be displayed if no ammo 
[*] Removed Ammo in Bonus 9
[*] Bigger hitbox for small enemies
[*] Important light optimisation on center room of Chapter 2 Special level
[*] Fixed DLSS setting not being saved
[*] Fixed crash when quick restarting on a bumper
[*] Fixed no toggle slow motion being inverted after a quick restart 
[*] Caped kill sound to 10 in buffer 
[/list]

[b]Accessibility[/b]

[list]
[*] Added option to disable Crosshair Color change hover enemies, causing visibility issues to Daltonians.
[/list]

[h3]LEVEL EDITOR[/h3]

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] New Autosaves System
[*] New Confirmation box UI
[*] Show downloaded levels in "Downloads Levels" window
[*] Removed grid and camera max height
[*] Grid and Camera with higher location (allow to build below starting position)
[*] Save grid’s height and scale during the session and restore it after testing a level
[*] Now show creator name in the thumbnail of the level
[*] Removed camera inertia
[*] Removed "New Level" button from "Save Load" window
[*] New basic blocks : 2xWall with round hole, ceiling, cylinder, spike & H?!
[*] New prefab : Small Room with 4 Doors
[*] Display map creator’s name
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Community Level Browser: fix description overflowing
[*] Show level name in Tab and End window
[*] Avoid Autosaves to be the last active save
[*] Allow to place elements without the grid active
[*] Bind Num pad “+” and  “-” to change the grid scale (was bound to camera speed before)
[*] Reload tips won’t be displayed if no ammo 
[*] Going back to brush mode will select last selected brush
[*] Added min/max for world settings 
[*] Fixed a crash in description when publishing 
[/list]

notes.title: New Closed Beta Update !
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

We have pushed a new version with a few small (and bigs) changes for the closed beta !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/1f759f3281151a577c6acb80fcb7b086b30e876d.png[/img]

[b]Changelist[/b] :

[b]Important features :[/b]
-Manoeuvrability at high speed improved (try Demo 5 Corner!)
-Momentum improved: keep more momentum when doing a bunny hop after a slide hop
-Slide hop speed increase
-Speed O Meter : uses an averaged speed value over the last 0.1sec and not instant speed for better visual results. So the speed value shown cannot be compared to the values you were getting with Micrologist’s implementation. Actual top speed can be slightly higher than the one displayed
-When you beat the gold medal on a tutorial, you will then see your own ghost and not the tutorial ghost
-Several kill sounds are played when you kill many enemies at once (with a melee for example)
-Bumper and slider in test map added  (added on test map)

We need your feedback on these, let us know if previous records are within reach, or if you want us to tweak the movements mechanics further.
We will then reset the highscores once you guys are happy with the improved character controller mechanics.

[b]Improvements :[/b]

- Collisions updated on various tutorials
- Medal time reduced for some of the tutorials
- UI to load test maps
- Bumper and slider in test map added 
- Options menu rework (better categories & improved readability)
- Options menu tooltips on mouse hover
- Slide jump consistency 
- Nvidia DLSS: better performance at no visual cost!
- No more level selection button in pause menu until you have finished intro tutorials 
- Calibration starts on first game launch and not when you click on “play the demo” 
- No more restart tips after getting the gold medal

[b]Bug Fixes :[/b]

- switched two level’s thumbnails (6 & 7)

PS: You can still get keys by joining our Discord/Twitter !
[url=https://discord.com/invite/vYv4QhgE7y][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/38a3e523fa40bbd7195cded5d69b34615d8f6360.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/warcrythegame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40523108/d3d24be4cdf401892601056be2de7196d1545db5.png[/img][/url]
